ProductDetails.artisanBody: Every stitch is made by UHDP-trained artisans in Narayanganj — earning livelihoods, not charity.

hero.description: Arpan is a humanitarian and livelihood-based initiative creating employment opportunities for underprivileged, disabled, and vulnerable individuals, enabling them to earn independently and live with dignity.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.tagline: Arpan means: Not charity, but opportunity.
mission.objective1: Make underprivileged and disabled individuals self-reliant
mission.objective2: Help them earn through dignified work instead of depending on charity
mission.objective3: Ensure their respectful inclusion in society
mission.objective4: Use a portion of generated income to support medical treatment for poor patients

impactStories.label: Real Impact
impactStories.title: Healthcare That Changes Lives
impactStories.intro: Through our partnership with UHDP (United Humanitarian Development Program), a portion of every Arpan purchase helps fund medical care for patients who cannot afford treatment. These stories reflect the real difference your support makes.

story1.title: Recovery Through Dedicated Care
story1.caption: Access to burn treatment and follow-up care
story1.description: With timely medical intervention and ongoing support from UHDP healthcare teams, this child received the treatment needed for recovery. Every purchase on Arpan helps extend similar care to more families in need.
story1.imageAlt: Before and after photos showing a child's recovery from burn injuries through medical treatment

story2.title: Care With Dignity
story2.caption: UHDP non-profit medical support
story2.description: UHDP workers provide hands-on medical support to children and families who lack access to affordable healthcare. Arpan channels shop proceeds into this network so vulnerable patients receive treatment with respect and compassion.
story2.imageAlt: UHDP caregiver holding a child receiving medical support

item1.title: Self-Reliance
item1.description: Empowering underprivileged and disabled individuals to become financially independent through dignified work opportunities.

item2.title: Dignified Work
item2.description: Creating employment that replaces dependency on charity with respect, skill development, and fair compensation.

item3.title: Social Inclusion
item3.description: Building a respectful place for artisans in society, recognizing their skills and contributions.

item4.title: Healthcare Impact
item4.description: Allocating profits to fund medical support for underserved communities in need.

item5.title: Community Building
item5.description: Creating a network of artisans, customers, and partners united by purpose and shared values.

item1.title: Creating Employment Opportunities
item1.description: We provide work to vulnerable and disabled individuals, enabling them to earn and support their families.

item2.title: Skill Development & Training
item2.description: For those without prior skills, we offer comprehensive training programs to build expertise and confidence.

item3.title: Product Collection & Development
item3.description: We collect artisan-made products and work to improve design, quality, and market appeal.

item4.title: Marketing & Sales
item4.description: We connect artisan products to conscious consumers through multiple channels.

item5.title: Fair Income Distribution
item5.description: We ensure fair wages for artisans and reinvest profits into healthcare programs.
